_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: [HIGH][issue lane, existing issue tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#101, carried] v1 webhook list and create are removed after 2027-01-01 (Connect-API-Code 3.2.5, the current production release: GET and POST /v1/webhooks deprecated, x-sunset 2027-01-01). Progress in this window: the inbound flow reads v1 and v2 deliveries (#247), and the rotation script moves an install onto a v2 subscription (#248, #251, #252). Still open against #101's acceptance: member installs are not migrated (needs this release shipped first), and QUICK_START.md at 1147273 still tells members to register on /v1/webhooks and not v2, which the docs change tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#249 corrects after the tag. #101 is labeled security and high-priority and is NOT in accepted_issues, so the release gate reports it as an unaccepted HIGH. Whether to accept it for this release is Shawn's call; this review does not add it (the 32cbc4b record pre-registered that accepting #101 to quiet the gate is a loosening).
notes: DELTA record: extends 32cbc4b across #238, #240, #241, #242, #245, #246, #247, #248, #250, #251 and #252 (git log 32cbc4b..1147273, 13 commits). Watched-path drift: zis/tsanet_connect_bundle.json and its zaf-build/assets copy (identical after the change), zaf-build/manifest.json (version line only, 1.0.71->1.0.72), scripts/security-audit.py, scripts/rotate-inbound-webhook.py, and comment-only changes to .github/workflows/release.yml, scripts/package.sh, zaf-build/assets/deploy.js.

INDEPENDENT: the reviewing session authored none of the changes under review (they came from a separate Coder session), so self_reviewed is false and independent_pass is true for this window. It does not re-review #237, which the 32cbc4b record marked self-reviewed.

#247 (NormalizeEvent): Cat3 blast radius unchanged. A forged delivery still needs the ZIS inbound Basic credential, and the flow still re-fetches the case from TSANet by token. GuardCreate stays an allow-list (StringEquals collaboration-request.created, Default NoOp); only the v2 creation type maps onto it, the other four v2 types fall to the update path or NoOp. New GuardEventToken sends a delivery with no string token to NoOp, a tightening. Cat4: v2 delivery data carries ids and tokens only (Connect-API-Code 3.2.5 WebhookCaseData, WebhookNoteData, WebhookResponseData), so the move to v2 puts no new data class into ZIS integration logs. Cat6: v2 deliveries are HMAC-signed and ZIS still cannot verify the signature (accepted limitation #90); Basic remains the boundary. tests/test_normalize_event.py runs the bundle's jq through the jq CLI for v1 and v2 inputs.

#248, #251, #252 (rotation onto v2): Cat2. The replacement subscription carries callbackAuth BASIC with the new credential (3.2.5 CreateWebhookSubscriptionV2RequestDTO has callbackAuth). New credentials go to a 0600 file and are never printed. The v2 create response's HMAC secret is neither printed nor stored. Scope is kept: v1 event types map to their v2 names and an unfiltered v1 subscription becomes an explicit two-type list rather than all five v2 types; caseDirections and partnerCompanyIds are copied. Revocation: DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id} is not deprecated and deletes v2 subscriptions too (3.2.5 WebhookService.deleteWebhookSubscription looks the id up in the one subscription table and checks the company). The deployed-bundle check fails closed. The duplicate sweep keeps only case ids, tokens, ticket ids and times. Register rows from this window: the sweep's token scope, and the token guard's breadth.

#250 (audit tooling): the v1-webhooks pattern now skips paths with an inline id. Matches the spec: in 3.2.5 only GET and POST /v1/webhooks are deprecated, and every /v1/webhooks/{id} operation (DELETE, POST secret, GET deliveries) is not. Differential on the 1147273 tree, the e649920^ script versus the 1147273 script: byte-identical output. tests/test_security_audit.py pins both sides (id forms pass; list, create, query string, joined id and unnamed placeholders still flag). No loosening.

MECHANICAL: 21 PASS / 1 WARN / 1 FAIL at 1147273 (network run). FAIL = 'no unexcused calls to sunsetting endpoints', 43 days to 2027-01-01: zaf-build/assets/background.html:96 (#153), scripts/rotate-inbound-webhook.py:161 GET /v1/webhooks (#101) and its test fixture tests/test_rotate_inbound_webhook.py:17. The check keeps failing after the date passes (days <= threshold), so it clears only when those calls are deleted. The rotation script's v1 list is needed to find v1 subscriptions while installs migrate, so it is the last of the three to go. release.yml maps any nonzero audit to flag_coverage, so every release until then publishes 'NOT covered by a current security audit'; approving one accepts that risk on the run. The 32cbc4b pre-registration stands: raising SUNSET_FAIL_WITHIN_DAYS, a blanket marker, or accepting #101 to quiet the gate would be a loosening.
TAG: this record covers 1147273. Tag the commit that carries this record (its watched-path diff from 1147273 is empty), not 1147273 itself, whose .security-audit.json still reads 32cbc4b.

DEV TOOLING (#245, informational, no finding): .claude/settings.json enables the tsanetgit/ai-devkit plugin marketplace with autoUpdate true. It is not in the shipped zip (package.sh packages manifest.json, assets/ and translations/), but it runs on developer hosts that hold release rights. Its source is a tsanetgit repo, the same trust domain as this one, and release publishing stays gated on the release environment.

NOT VERIFIED: whether ZIS URL-encodes {{$.requestToken}} in action_get_collaboration (register row); whether tickets:read covers GET /api/v2/tickets?external_id= (register row); TSANet's v1 delivery behavior after 2027-01-01; PROD-paired ZIS behavior with v2 deliveries (the Coder session's end-to-end runs were on BETA and its paired test instance, not repeated here).

sites: zaf-build/assets/background.html:96 - GET /v1/webhooks, marker `audit-degrades: v1-webhooks until 2027-01-01 tracked-by tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#153`, shipped in the bundle members install. Once v1 is removed the v2 answer beside it is discarded (the code comment says so); deleting the call is #153.

scripts/rotate-inbound-webhook.py:161 - GET /v1/webhooks, marker tracked-by tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#101. Operator tool, not shipped in the zip. Stops the run if v1 cannot be listed before the sunset, warns and continues on v2 after it.
tests/test_rotate_inbound_webhook.py:17 - the test fixture for the call above, marker tracked-by tsanetgit/Zendesk_App#101. Goes with it.
